Step Into the Canopy
Discover the tranquil side of Miami at Treehouse Hotel. Nestled near Biscayne Bay and just minutes from the Design District, Brickell, and Miami Beach, our boutique hotel offers the perfect balance of relaxation and convenience. Stay close to Miami's top attractions while enjoying peaceful comfort, free parking, modern amenities, and a true South Florida retreat at your own pace.

Every room is curated for comfort and convenience, and we're pleased to offer
free parking for all guests . Our commitment to attentive hospitality ensures each stay is effortless and memorable. At Treehouse Hotel, we bring together local charm and contemporary efficiency to deliver an experience that delights travelers and reflects the spirit of Miami.
